thread:
incident-bot: ALERT — Azure vWAN (northeurope) detected intermittent egress path flapping affecting PrivateLink and ExpressRoute-attached hubs. Potentially impacting on-prem customers using dedicated routes. Autopager triggered.

jake (oncall): I'm paged, grabbing context. Who's on netops?

neha (netops): seeing BGP session resets from the hub to MSFT backbone around 15:42 UTC. Dropped routes to some onprem prefixes. Metric: 15-45s path blackholes then recovery.

lena (support-ops): Multiple customers reporting 504s to private endpoints and database connections timing out. Ticket numbers: C-4729, C-4732. Severity is high for a few paying Dedicated customers.

maria (eng-infra): Collecting diagnostics: grabbing vWAN hub logs, route table snapshots, and peering health. Running `az network vwan list-hub-connections --resource-group prod-network --hub-name vwan-ne` now.

charlie (sre-lead): @jake, prioritize customer-facing mitigation: failover traffic to secondary hub in westeurope if possible, or enable route priority override to prefer MPLS path. Also prepare rollback plan.

jake (oncall): On it. Trying to push a route override to prefer spoke->westeurope-hub for affected prefixes. If ARM API fails, manual route table change in portal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: oncall -> sre-lead -> netops. Escalation sent at 15:50 UTC :rotating_light:

maria (eng-infra): Diagnostic dump: `BGPSessions: hub1->msft: flaps=12, last_reset=2025-03-23T15:49:11Z`. Also seeing DNS SRV resolution delays for private DNS zones served via vnet-link. That could explain application 504s.

neha (netops): MSFT NOC ticket opened: INC0123456. They report "internal backbone maintenance causing transient route convergence issues in northeurope"; asking for packet captures and trace routes.

lena (support-ops): I've notified affected customers with initial message: we're investigating, mitigation in progress, next update in 15m. Logged impact: app timeouts and intermittent failures to on-prem databases. :white_check_mark: 

jake (oncall): I executed route override. Confirming propagation... `az network route-table route update --name route-override --route-table-name rt-spoke-01 --next-hop-type VirtualAppliance --next-hop-ip 10.2.0.7` — update returned 202 Accepted.

maria (eng-infra): Seeing partial propagation. Traffic for customer prefixes X.Y.0.0/24 and A.B.0.0/22 now rerouting via westeurope-hub for some spokes. Still some spokes flapping.

charlie (sre-lead): If propagation is slow, start application-level fallbacks for critical customers: switch DB reads to replicas in other region, enable circuit-breakers. Notify product owners.

support-ops (lena): Contacted top-3 impacted customers with suggested mitigation steps (short term): add retry/backoff, toggle multi-region DB read preference.

maria (eng-infra): MSFT NOC provided guidance: they're rolling back a config change, ETA 30-45m for stable BGP sessions. Requested we do no route churn until they confirm.

neha (netops): Agree no further route tinkering. Reverting any partial overrides where they cause asymmetric paths. Will monitor BGP. Adding watch on `bgpEstablished` metric.

jake (oncall): Logging current action list: 1) Hold changes (per MSFT) 2) Monitor BGP e2e 3) Customer comms every 15m 4) Prepare for controlled failover if rollback fails.

incident-bot: Next automated status update scheduled in 15 minutes.

microsoft-noc-bot: MSFT NOC update: rollback started at 15:58 UTC, will post when stable. Ticket INC0123456.

lena (support-ops): Customer update sent at 16:00 UTC. Two customers confirmed improved connectivity for some flows.

charlie (sre-lead): Handoff note for next shift (cc @pagerduty): we are in monitoring. Primary risk: recurrence until MSFT rollout confirmed. No config changes until NOC clear. If BGP sessions drop <3x within 10m, trigger full failover plan.

pagerduty: Acknowledged. Next oncall (neha) will take lead for 16:30–20:30 UTC.

neha (netops): Taking lead. I'll request periodic BGP dumps and ping checks to onprem edge. Also will ask MSFT for per-hop traceroutes for affected prefixes.

maria (eng-infra): Saved logs and exported `az network watcher` captures to storage account `rbw-incident-1749854321`. Links posted to the incident ticket.

microsoft-noc-bot: Update: BGP sessions stabilized at 16:18 UTC after rollback. Observed no further route withdraws for last 12 minutes.

lena (support-ops): Notifying customers of stabilization. Recommended they verify and reopen tickets if issues persist.

charlie (sre-lead): Post-incident actions: 1) Run a blameless RCA with MSFT coordination, 2) Add automated detection rule for this fingerprint (BGP reset pattern + private DNS SRV delays), 3) Improve onprem failover playbook.

jake (oncall): Leaving detailed handoff in runbook + links. Marking incident as 'monitoring' and handing to neha. Thanks all.

neha (netops): Thanks — will keep watch for 2h then transition to normal ops if stable. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed to updates after final ack at 16:25 UTC. Archive will include logs and MSFT ticket.
